title: Which Prophet Are You?
subtitle: Which voice in the wilderness sounds like yours?

questions.text: When God calls, your first response usually sounds like...

options.text: Here am I; send me.
I'm too young / unqualified for this.
I'm going the opposite direction first.
Just give me a quiet cave to hide in.

questions.text: What burdens your heart most these days?

options.text: A people who've forgotten holiness.
Watching the city you love drift away.
A nation that feels spiritually dead.
Love that has gone cold.

questions.text: How do you tend to deliver truth?

options.text: Poetic, soaring, full of vision.
Tearful and aching for the people.
Bizarre, dramatic, hard to ignore.
Through the lived shape of my life.
Pray three times a day with my window open.
Run dramatically into the wilderness.
Refuse to speak — and then can't help speaking.
Wait for visions to make it make sense.

questions.text: Pick the scene that most resonates:

options.text: A throne room with a seraph and a coal.
A valley of dry bones standing up.
A still small voice in a cave.
Three friends walking out of a furnace.

questions.text: How do you handle hostile rooms?

options.text: Speak truth even when it gets me hated.
Stand firm and refuse to bow.
Get angry, then take a nap under a tree.
Tell the story God's writing through me.

questions.text: What does God's mercy look like to you?

options.text: Mercy over sacrifice — every time.
Mercy that follows me when I run.
Mercy that shuts the lions' mouths.
Mercy that breathes life into bones.
Use me — I want to be sent.
Help me speak when I'd rather quit.
Show me Your glory — even a glimpse.
Help me love the people You love.

isaiah.name: Isaiah the Sent
isaiah.description: You've seen the throne room — even just a glimpse — and it ruined you for small living. When God asks who'll go, your hand is already up.

jeremiah.name: Jeremiah the Weeping Prophet
jeremiah.description: You feel everything God feels about the people. You try to be quiet, but His word burns in your bones — you couldn't stop speaking even if you wanted to.

ezekiel.name: Ezekiel the Visionary
ezekiel.description: Your imagination is wired for what God can resurrect. You see dry bones and start prophesying anyway — because you trust the breath is coming.

daniel.name: Daniel the Steady
daniel.description: You hold the line quietly. In rooms that don't share your values, you keep your window open toward home — and God closes the lions' mouths.

hosea.name: Hosea the Heartbroken
hosea.description: You preach with the shape of your life. You've kept loving the very thing that left, and that's exactly how God says He loves us.

jonah.name: Jonah the Runner
jonah.description: You'll run a long way before you'll obey — because deep down you knew God was going to be merciful, and that made you mad. But the mercy chasing you is also for you.

elijah.name: Elijah at the Cave
elijah.description: You've called down fire and then collapsed under a tree. God meets you in the wilderness with food, sleep, and a whisper — not a shout.
